parameters.content:
Weekly Automation Trigger
Runs the competitor intelligence workflow automatically every week and starts a new analysis cycle.

Competitor Setup
Defines the competitors to monitor and prepares the run ID and report date for the weekly analysis.

Review Data Collection
Collects review signals for each configured competitor. Currently uses controlled synthetic test data for workflow testing.

Process Competitors Individually
Processes one competitor at a time so each competitor receives separate AI analysis before moving to the next.

AI Competitor Intelligence
Analyzes customer reviews for recurring themes, sentiment patterns, strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.

Normalize Intelligence Data
Converts each AI result into a consistent competitor-level structure for aggregation and downstream reporting.

Aggregate Competitor Results
Collects the completed analysis for all competitors into one consolidated intelligence dataset for comparison.

Cross-Competitor Intelligence
Compares all analyzed competitors to identify common patterns, key differences, customer pain points, and evidence-based opportunities.

Report Generation & Formatting
Converts AI outputs into a structured HTML business report and prepares clean fields for Google Sheets and Gmail delivery.

Report Storage
Saves the weekly competitor intelligence results in Google Sheets for historical tracking and future analysis.

Email Report Delivery
Sends the formatted HTML competitor intelligence report automatically to the configured recipient.
